title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything: turn desktop applications into agent-ready command tools
friendlyTitle: CLI-Anything helps agents control normal software
summary: CLI-Anything generates command-line interfaces around existing software so agents can operate applications through structured commands. The heavily starred project includes a hub of generated integrations and plugins for coding-agent environments.
friendlySummary: This project creates command tools for existing applications. AI agents can then use clear commands instead of clicking around the screen.
whyItMatters: It can expose repeatable application actions to agents without relying on fragile mouse-and-screen automation. Review generated commands, permissions and undo behaviour before allowing unattended changes.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can make automation more reliable. Test the generated commands and make sure important actions can be limited or undone.
